options.name: apiPassword
options.description: The password for use in authentication with the Atlas API. Can use API users and tokens (private key is password)

options.name: apiUsername
options.description: The username for use in authentication with the Atlas API. Can use API users and tokens (public key is username)

options.name: autoScaling
options.description: Configure your cluster to automatically scale its storage and cluster tier.

options.name: clusterType
options.description: Type of the cluster that you want to create.

options.name: diskSizeGB
options.description: Capacity, in gigabytes, of the host's root volume. Increase this number to add capacity, up to a maximum possible value of 4096 (i.e., 4 TB). This value must be a positive integer.

options.name: groupId
options.description: Unique identifier for the Atlas project.

options.name: mongoDBMajorVersion
options.description: Version of the cluster to deploy. Atlas always deploys the cluster with the latest stable release of the specified version. You can upgrade to a newer version of MongoDB when you modify a cluster.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the cluster as it appears in Atlas. Once the cluster is created, its name cannot be changed.

options.name: pitEnabled
options.description: Flag that indicates the cluster uses continuous cloud backups.

options.name: providerBackupEnabled
options.description: Flag that indicates if the cluster uses Cloud Backups for backups.

options.name: providerSettings
options.description: Configuration for the provisioned servers on which MongoDB runs. The available options are specific to the cloud service provider.

options.name: replicationFactor
options.description: Number of replica set members. Each member keeps a copy of your databases, providing high availability and data redundancy.
